subject: plotting the results of an averaged model

messages.subject: plotting the results of an averaged model
parts:
Hello,

I have been using package MuMin to do model averaging, but I am having trouble visualizing my results. I get lovely tables of averaged coefficients, but I'd love to be able to graph the partial residuals of each term to get a good idea of what they actually mean, and I can't figure out how to do it. I have used function "termplot" from the base packege to graph terms from each individual model, but it won't do it for averaged models. I have also used package "visreg" to make even pretty grams of the terms of glms with partial residuals, but it doesn't work with averaged models either. There doesn't seem to be any function to plot averaged models automatically, but does anyone know any way of calculating and plotting partial residuals given a set of coefficients?

Thanks
